text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, do you want to go get some cake 
together?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ sorry. My clothes have been getting a 
bit tight lately, so I'm holding back on 
sweets.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Understood. Then I'll pick 
somewhere that isn't all-you-can-eat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, all-you-can-eat or not isn't the 
problem... I'm a light eater to begin 
with.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's skip the cake and get crepes 
instead, then.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sounds good! Crepes are thin and 
light, so they'll easily fit into my tiny 
stomach— ...Wait, why am I playing along?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm on a diet! Just wait until my waist 
gets back to normal!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tamamo Cross overcame sweet 
temptations and successfully pulled off 
her diet.
